g.text: Does association differ within a cluster?
Machine learning describes PLA morphology; animals remain the replicates
Unsupervised k=3 models use area and shape only. ChAT association and running labels are inspected afterward; neither is used to fit the clusters.
Left: sampled objects; labels show full eligible-object medians. C1–C3 are area-ranked within each arm, not cell identities. A zero diameter can reflect measurement precision.
49,618/310,024 PLA objects excluded from morphology modeling. Middle/right: animal dots and equal-animal means (n=3/group); primary unfiltered results remain unchanged.
